title: Vortex Beetle Juice 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Tidal Vape Vortex Nic Salt Beetle Juice delivers a vibrant mix of tropical fruit flavours, creating a bold and exotic vaping experience. This juicy medley balances sweetness and tanginess, providing layers of rich and refreshing flavour in every puff. Crafted with a 50VG/50PG ratio, Beetle Juice ensures smooth vapour production and full-bodied flavour, making it ideal for Mouth-To-Lung (MTL) pod kits and starter devices. The nicotine salt formulation offers a smooth throat hit and quick nicotine satisfaction, ensuring an enjoyable and effortless vape. Presented in a 10ml format, Tidal Vape Vortex Nic Salts offer a more economical and sustainable alternative to disposable vape bars. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, Beetle Juice is perfect for vapers seeking bold, tropical flavours.
